content: गण्डः .²1 The cheek, the whole side of the face including the temples; गण्डाभोगे पुलकपटलम् <ls>Māl. 2. 5</ls>; तदीषदार्द्रारुणगण्डलेखम् <ls>Ku. 7. 82</ls>; <ls>Me. 26</ls>, <ls n="Me.">93</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 83</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 4. 6</ls>, <ls n="Ṛs.">6. 10</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6. 18</ls>; <ls>Śi. 12. 54</ls>. .²2 An elephantʼs temple; गण्डोड्डीनालिमाला˚ <ls>Māl. 1. 1</ls>. .²3 A bubble. .²4 A boil, tumour, swelling, pimple; अयमपरो गण्डस्योपरि विस्फोटः <ls>Mu. 5</ls>; तदा गण्डस्योपरि पिटिका संवृत्ता <ls>Ś. 2</ls>. .²5 Goitre and other excrescences of the neck. .²6 A joint, knot. .²7 A mark, spot; गण्डोज्ज्वलामुज्ज्वलनाभिचक्रया <ls>Śi. 12. 8</ls>. .²8 A rhinoceros. .²9 The bladder. .²10 A hero, warrior. .²11 Part of a horseʼs trappings, a stud or button fixed as an ornament upon the harness. .²12 An unexpected combination of words consisting in putting one speech immediately after another, so as to be syntactically connected; see वीथि; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} राक्षसः--अपि नाम दुरात्मा चाणक्यवटुः . दौवारिकः--जयतु . -रा˚ -अतिसंधातुं शक्यः स्यात् . --दौ˚-अमात्यः . <ls>Mu. 4</ls>; so किमस्या न प्रेयो यदि पुनरसह्यस्तु विरहः. -दौ˚-देव उपस्थितः <ls>U. 1</ls> .²13 The tenth yoga or one of the twenty-seven portions of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic. .²14 An astronomical period.
